partners.mechanism_chain: SOX9 (HGNC:11145) —DISRUPTS→ Spermatogenesis and Sertoli cell development (GO:0001705); Spermatogenesis and Sertoli cell development (GO:0001705) —LEADS_TO→ 46,XX sex reversal (HP:0001407); SOX9 (HGNC:11145) —DISRUPTS→ Neuronal differentiation and migration (GO:0048667); Neuronal differentiation and migration (GO:0048667) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Neuronal differentiation and migration (GO:0048667) —LEADS_TO→ Gastrointestinal difficulties (HP:0002062); Neuronal differentiation and migration (GO:0048667) —LEADS_TO→ High pain threshold (HP:0011415). Disruption of SOX9 function leads to distinct but mechanistically related developmental outcomes.
